title: Colorado Photographic Arts Center

services.name: Darkroom Rentals
services.desc: With an increased amount of space and equipment, up to three people at a time can work within the darkroom. Rental fees include everything except paper. Renters can bring both RC and fiber-based papers. We no longer cap the number of rolls of film you process or the number of prints you make. If you choose to bring your own chemicals, please note: we do not allow powder chemicals to be mixed
